briefing: Markets sold off sharply today with NASDAQ down 2.4% and the S&P 500 down 1.3%, putting the environment firmly in risk-off territory. With no screened candidates available and no risk-on confirmation signals present, we held all 7 existing positions and kept cash in reserve rather than forcing new buys.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors broadly sell riskier assets like growth stocks and tech shares and move toward safety, causing indices like the NASDAQ to fall more sharply than broader benchmarks like the S&P 500. The smart move on these days is usually to hold steady rather than chase new positions, since volatility tends to punish fresh buys made without clear confirmation signals.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險規避」(risk-off)是指投資者普遍賣出成長股、科技股等較高風險的資產,轉向較安全的資產,導致納斯達克等指數跌幅往往大於標普500等較廣泛的指標。在這種日子裡,較穩健的做法通常是按兵不動,而非在缺乏明確訊號確認下追高買進新倉位,因為市場波動容易讓倉促的買入決策蒙受損失。

market_education.summary_en: Broad-based selling hit growth and tech-heavy names hardest today, dragging the NASDAQ down 2.4% versus a smaller 1.3% decline in the S&P 500, a pattern typical of risk-off days when investors rotate out of higher-beta positions. No specific confirmed headlines were available in today's feed to pinpoint a single catalyst. The scale and breadth of the decline across major indices suggests a broad macro or sentiment-driven pullback rather than a single-stock event.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日市場出現廣泛拋售,科技股及成長股受創最深,帶動納斯達克指數下跌2.4%,跌幅大於標普500指數的1.3%,這種走勢是典型的「風險規避」(risk-off)模式,投資者傾向減持高波動性資產。今日新聞來源中並未提供具體標題以確認單一導火線。從主要指數普遍下跌的幅度與廣度來看,這更像是宏觀面或市場情緒驅動的整體回調,而非單一個股事件。
